description: List the properties Timeline can animate — its interpolable models. Pass object_id to keep only the ones that apply to that scene object, which is the way to find out what is animatable on a character versus a light versus an item. Timeline ships around 38 built-in models (camera, time scale, visibility, guide-object position/rotation/scale, character animation, clothing states, face, hands, item colours and patterns, light settings); other plugins publish their own under their own 'owner'. A model marked 'dynamic' animates one target at a time and needs studio_timeline_add_interpolable to be given a 'target'. Requires the Timeline plugin.

object_id.description: scene object id from studio_list_objects; filters to the models that accept it

query.description: case-insensitive substring matched against the model id and its label

owner.description: 'Timeline' for the built-in models, otherwise the publishing plugin

dynamic.description: true when the model animates one target at a time and needs a 'target'
